profile.summary: guybedford demonstrates **junior-level JavaScript expertise** primarily focused on **legacy frontend development**, particularly with **jQuery**. Their contributions involve **DOM manipulation, AMD module system fixes, and circular dependency resolution**, indicating familiarity with **pre-ES6 JavaScript patterns** and **modularity challenges** in older codebases. While their work shows **attention to code quality (linting) and structural refactoring**, there is **no evidence of modern JavaScript frameworks (React, Vue, etc.), TypeScript, or backend development**. Their contributions are **syntax/structure-focused**, suggesting experience in **maintaining and improving legacy JavaScript code** rather than building new systems. Overall, this profile reflects a **front-end junior developer** with **specialized knowledge in jQuery and AMD-based projects**, but limited exposure to contemporary JavaScript ecosystems.
